name: Sherlock Holmes and the Hound of the Baskervilles

locations.note: Holmes and Watson travel to Baskerville Hall on the moor to confront the family's hound curse.
Sir Henry Baskerville and Dr Mortimer bring the legend of the hound to Holmes in London before the party leaves for Devon.
The case opens in the rooms at 221B.

routes.name: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson
routes.note: Sir Henry's tale of the family curse draws Holmes and Watson from rainy Baker Street to Baskerville Hall and out onto the moor to face the hound.
